The '''SFX Smoke Generator''' was a small disk shaped effects generator designed primarily for entertainment use. [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] were able to put these devices to good use, however, as means of creating concealment and disrupting blaster fire.<ref name="ROE" />
